lead_html: This pan has no tonic triad, so the cards here are the three the app ranks first. Play each card's lit notes, then move to the next.
history_html: Akebono is a pentatonic scale from Japanese music. Makers say it comes from the In scale, and the pentatonic that comes from In is called Miyako-Bushi, used on traditional instruments such as the shamisen and koto. Isthmus Instruments says the notes of the scale make a lot of dissonance, yet it pairs well with minor scales. Both makers list this layout the same way: F# ding, then B C# D F# G B C# D. MAG calls the sound deep, hypnotic and alluring, with an Eastern flair.
og_description: F# Akebono 9 handpan chords: three chord cards with the notes to play, then practice in the free chord flashcard app.
